from __future__ import annotations

import sqlite3
import subprocess
from pathlib import Path

ROOT = Path.home() / ".local/share/prediction-project-executor/campaigns/FULL-A2Z-LIVE-20261004-V4"
TASK_ID = "A2Z-V4-SOL-PROPOSAL-20261006-R2"
UNIT = "prediction-a2z-v4-model@A2Z-V4-SOL-PROPOSAL-20261006-R2.service"
RESULT = ROOT / "model_results" / f"{TASK_ID}.json"
DB = ROOT / "models" / "runtime.sqlite"

if RESULT.is_file() and not RESULT.is_symlink():
    print("SOL_R2_CLASSIFICATION=RESULT_NOW_PRESENT")
    print("NEXT=REVERIFY_R2")
    raise SystemExit(0)

service = {}
cp = subprocess.run(
    ["systemctl", "--user", "show", UNIT],
    text=True,
    capture_output=True,
    timeout=20,
    check=False,
)
for line in cp.stdout.splitlines():
    if "=" not in line:
        continue
    k, v = line.split("=", 1)
    if k in {"ActiveState", "SubState", "Result", "ExecMainStatus", "ExecMainCode"}:
        service[k] = v

status = "NO_TASK_ROW"
reason = "NO_TRANSITION"
retry = "0"
attempt = "0"

if DB.is_file() and not DB.is_symlink():
    db = sqlite3.connect(f"file:{DB}?mode=ro", uri=True)
    try:
        row = db.execute(
            "select status,attempt from tasks where id=?",
            (TASK_ID,),
        ).fetchone()
        tr = db.execute(
            "select state,reason,attempt,retry from transitions "
            "where task=? order by seq desc limit 1",
            (TASK_ID,),
        ).fetchone()
    finally:
        db.close()
    if row:
        status = str(row[0])
        attempt = str(row[1])
    if tr:
        reason = str(tr[1])
        retry = str(tr[3] or 0)
        if status == "NO_TASK_ROW":
            status = str(tr[0])
        attempt = str(tr[2])

if status == "PAUSED_USAGE_LIMIT":
    classification = "PAUSED_USAGE_LIMIT"
elif status == "WAITING_RETRY":
    classification = "WAITING_RETRY"
elif status == "FAILED":
    classification = "MODEL_TASK_FAILED"
elif status == "RUNNING":
    classification = "RUNNING_WITHOUT_RESULT"
elif status == "COMPLETE":
    classification = "COMPLETE_WITHOUT_RESULT"
elif status == "QUEUED":
    classification = "QUEUED_NOT_COMPLETED"
elif status == "NO_TASK_ROW":
    classification = "TASK_NOT_ENQUEUED"
else:
    classification = "UNEXPECTED_RUNTIME_STATUS"

print("SOL_R2_CLASSIFICATION=" + classification)
print("SOL_R2_TASK_STATUS=" + status)
print("SOL_R2_ATTEMPT=" + attempt)
print("SOL_R2_LAST_REASON=" + reason)
print("SOL_R2_RETRY_AT=" + retry)
print("SYSTEMD_ACTIVE=" + service.get("ActiveState", "UNKNOWN"))
print("SYSTEMD_SUB=" + service.get("SubState", "UNKNOWN"))
print("SYSTEMD_RESULT=" + service.get("Result", "UNKNOWN"))
print("SYSTEMD_EXEC_MAIN_STATUS=" + service.get("ExecMainStatus", "UNKNOWN"))
print("NO_ASTRA_BUILD_TEST_OR_MEASUREMENT=1")
raise SystemExit(10)
